about: ASSET-004 early repaint recipe: the Hive Brute's method (kit_tools/troll_repaint.py) scaled to the Shaman (distances / 1.75). Mask = repaint/seer_hive_mask.png in the Shaman Cube's UV0 (R bark, G extremity darkening, B blight veins = emission, A dark roots + the gullet behind the jaw), lines computed at 2048 and box-filtered to 1024. The vanilla texture is only 128 px: the runtime upsamples it to the mask's 1024 before recolouring (a new Texture2D; vanilla pixels are read back, never shipped).
bark_texture: olivetree_trunk01 (TheHive_Mat _MainTex), triplanar in rest-pose metres, tile 0.69 m
veins: off the head; faded out within 0.25-0.5 m of the Hive eyes
antlers: its own antlers weathered toward grey-brown bark: 0.45 x vanilla + 0.55 x luminance x [0.62, 0.55, 0.46] (they sat bone-pale next to the dark branches)
